findings.title: Unused parameter removed without deprecation
findings.body: The parameter `treat_as_secure_origin` was removed from the constructor signature on line 82, but it is still referenced in the method body on line 264. This will raise a `TypeError` when the method is called with that argument. Either restore the parameter or remove all references to it.

findings.title: Path normalization may break cookie path matching
findings.body: The added line `path = path.rstrip("/")` on line 213 normalizes the path by removing trailing slashes. This can break RFC 6265 path matching logic that relies on exact path prefixes, especially when the cookie path ends with a slash and the request path does not. Consider preserving the original path structure or adjusting the matching logic accordingly.

findings.title: New shared cookie logic lacks documentation
findings.body: The new block starting at line 266 adds logic to send shared cookies without any inline comment or docstring explaining its purpose or the RFC 6265 rationale. Add a comment describing why shared cookies are handled separately and how this aligns with the RFC.
findings.suggestion:
# Send shared cookies (RFC 6265 section 5.4): cookies with empty domain and path
        # are sent on all requests regardless of origin.

findings.title: Inefficient cookie lookup using itertools.product
findings.body: The new cookie lookup logic uses `itertools.product(domains, paths)` to generate all (domain, path) pairs, which can be inefficient for domains with many subdomains and long paths. This may impact performance in high-traffic scenarios. Consider optimizing the lookup or caching the results.

findings.title: Unused variable `path_len` in cookie filtering
findings.body: The variable `path_len` is assigned on line 290 but only used in the condition on line 300. This adds unnecessary cognitive load. Either remove the variable and use `len(request_url.path)` directly in the condition, or rename it to clarify its purpose.
findings.suggestion: # Use len(request_url.path) directly instead of storing in path_len

summary.problem: The cookie jar refactor introduces correctness issues, inefficiencies, and missing documentation that could affect cookie handling behavior and performance.
summary.done_well: The change improves path handling and introduces shared cookie logic, aligning with RFC 6265. The removal of unused imports and type hints is clean.
